theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (Φ : Eucl n → Eucl P) (Ω : Set (Eucl n)) (W : Set (Eucl P)) (f : Eucl P → ℝ) (J g : Eucl P → ℝ≥0∞) (μ ν : Measure (Eucl P)), IsOpen Ω → Continuous Φ → InjOn Φ Ω → Measurable f → MeasurableSet W → W ⊆ Φ '' Ω → (∀ w₀ ∈ Ω, Φ w₀ ∈ W → ∃ O : Set (Eucl n), IsOpen O ∧ w₀ ∈ O ∧ ∀ S : Set (Eucl n), MeasurableSet S → S ⊆ O ∩ (Ω ∩ Φ ⁻¹' W) → AEMeasurable (fun t : ℝ => ∫⁻ x in Φ '' S ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}, g x ∂ν) (volume : Measure ℝ) ∧ ∫⁻ t, (∫⁻ x in Φ '' S ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}, g x ∂ν) ∂(volume : Measure ℝ) = ∫⁻ x in Φ '' S, J x * g x ∂μ) → AEMeasurable (fun t : ℝ => ∫⁻ x in W ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}, g x ∂ν) (volume : Measure ℝ) ∧ ∫⁻ t, (∫⁻ x in W ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}, g x ∂ν) ∂(volume : Measure ℝ) = ∫⁻ x in W, J x * g x ∂μ
